caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet featuring a light brown to reddish-brown coloration with darker brown accents for shading and detail. The cabinet has three main sections: a lower section with a single large drawer, a middle section with a central door paneled in a rectangular style, and an upper section that is smaller, also with a single paneled door. There are two vertical, dark-colored turned columns situated at the front corners of the upper section, connecting the topmost shelf to the middle portion of the cabinet. The sides of the cabinet are depicted at an angle, giving a three-dimensional perspective. The background is plain and off-white with no other objects present.
title: Press Cupboard
